root:
usage: hwp-workbench [-h] [--version]
                     {capabilities,inspect,extract,validate,plan,apply,save,read,search,replace,fill,set,propose,session,convert,mcp,mcp-config,open,rpc,skill} ...

Local HWP/HWPX preservation editor — development alpha.

positional arguments:
  {capabilities,inspect,extract,validate,plan,apply,save,read,search,replace,fill,set,propose,session,convert,mcp,mcp-config,open,rpc,skill}
                        Operation to run.
    capabilities        List supported operations and safety limits.
    inspect             Inspect native text nodes and compatibility warnings.
    extract             Extract document text without node references.
    validate            Check bounded native container and parse integrity.
    plan                Validate a patch and show changes without writing.
    apply               Apply a reviewed patch to a new native document file.
    save                Replace the source after native verification, with a
                        kept previous version.
    read                Read paged text with short node references.
    search              Find text and return native node IDs and offsets.
    replace             Preview term replacements or save a new document copy.
    fill                Preview form values or save a new document copy.
    set                 Preview one text-node edit or save a new document
                        copy.
    propose             Write a validated patch for desktop review without
                        changing the document.
    session             Read Agent link state and proposal outcomes without
                        writing.
    convert             Report an explicit, lossy format export; optionally
                        save a new file.
    mcp                 Run the local stdio MCP server.
    mcp-config          Print MCP client setup; does not run clients or edit
                        configuration.
    open                Open a native document in the desktop app for visual
                        review.
    rpc                 Run one desktop JSON request from stdin.
    skill               Install, inspect or remove the Claude Code and Codex
                        skill.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             Show the application version.
capabilities:
usage: hwp-workbench capabilities [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
inspect:
usage: hwp-workbench inspect [-h] [--root ROOT] [--compact] path

Inspect native text nodes and compatibility warnings.

positional arguments:
  path         Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --compact    Omit the structure view and package parts.
extract:
usage: hwp-workbench extract [-h] [--root ROOT] [--format {text,json}] path

Extract document text without node references.

positional arguments:
  path                  Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --format {text,json}  Output format (default: json).
validate:
usage: hwp-workbench validate [-h] [--root ROOT] path

Check bounded native container and parse integrity.

positional arguments:
  path         Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
plan:
usage: hwp-workbench plan [-h] [--root ROOT] --patch PATCH path

Validate a patch and show changes without writing.

positional arguments:
  path           Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT    Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --patch PATCH  JSON patch or edit-preview file inside workspace.
apply:
usage: hwp-workbench apply [-h] [--root ROOT] --patch PATCH -o OUTPUT
                           [--acknowledge-risks]
                           path

Apply a reviewed patch to a new native document file.

positional arguments:
  path                 Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT          Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --patch PATCH        JSON patch or edit-preview file inside workspace.
  -o, --output OUTPUT  New same-format output path; must not exist.
  --acknowledge-risks  Acknowledge compatibility warnings before saving.
save:
usage: hwp-workbench save [-h] [--root ROOT] --patch PATCH
                          [--acknowledge-risks] [--backup-dir BACKUP_DIR]
                          path

Replace the source after native verification, with a kept previous version.

positional arguments:
  path                  Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --patch PATCH         JSON patch or edit-preview file inside workspace.
  --acknowledge-risks   Acknowledge compatibility warnings before replacing
                        the source.
  --backup-dir BACKUP_DIR
                        Backup folder inside the workspace (default: beside
                        the source in .hwp-workbench/backups).
read:
usage: hwp-workbench read [-h] [--root ROOT] [--format {text,json}]
                          [--offset OFFSET] [--limit LIMIT]
                          path

Read paged text with short node references.

positional arguments:
  path                  Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --format {text,json}  Output format (default: json).
  --offset OFFSET       First text-node index (default: 0).
  --limit LIMIT         Maximum text nodes (default: 200; maximum: 1000).
search:
usage: hwp-workbench search [-h] [--root ROOT] [--regex] [--case-sensitive |
                            --ignore-case] [--limit LIMIT] [--query QUERY]
                            path [query_text]

Find text and return native node IDs and offsets.

positional arguments:
  path              Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.
  query_text        Text to find; alternative to --query.

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT       Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --regex           Use bounded fixed-width regex syntax.
  --case-sensitive  Match case exactly (replace default).
  --ignore-case     Ignore case (search default).
  --limit LIMIT     Maximum matches (maximum: 1000).
  --query QUERY     Text to find; alternative to positional query.
replace:
usage: hwp-workbench replace [-h] [--root ROOT] [-o OUTPUT]
                             [--acknowledge-risks] [--regex]
                             [--case-sensitive | --ignore-case]
                             [--limit LIMIT] --find FIND
                             --replace-with REPLACE_WITH [--node-id NODE_ID]
                             path

Preview term replacements or save a new document copy.

positional arguments:
  path                  Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  -o, --output OUTPUT   New same-format output path; must not exist.
  --acknowledge-risks   Acknowledge compatibility warnings before saving.
  --regex               Use bounded fixed-width regex syntax.
  --case-sensitive      Match case exactly (replace default).
  --ignore-case         Ignore case (search default).
  --limit LIMIT         Maximum matches (maximum: 1000).
  --find FIND           Term or supported regex to find.
  --replace-with REPLACE_WITH
                        Literal replacement text.
  --node-id NODE_ID     Full ID or short reference; repeat to restrict
                        targets.
fill:
usage: hwp-workbench fill [-h] [--root ROOT] [-o OUTPUT] [--acknowledge-risks]
                          (--json JSON | --field FIELD)
                          path

Preview form values or save a new document copy.

positional arguments:
  path                 Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT          Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  -o, --output OUTPUT  New same-format output path; must not exist.
  --acknowledge-risks  Acknowledge compatibility warnings before saving.
  --json JSON          JSON label/value object file inside workspace.
  --field FIELD        LABEL=VALUE; repeat for each field.
set:
usage: hwp-workbench set [-h] [--root ROOT] [-o OUTPUT] [--acknowledge-risks]
                         --node-id NODE_ID --text TEXT
                         path

Preview one text-node edit or save a new document copy.

positional arguments:
  path                 Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT          Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  -o, --output OUTPUT  New same-format output path; must not exist.
  --acknowledge-risks  Acknowledge compatibility warnings before saving.
  --node-id NODE_ID    Full node ID or short reference from read.
  --text TEXT          New plain-text value for the node.
propose:
usage: hwp-workbench propose [-h] [--root ROOT] --patch PATCH --title TITLE
                             [--author AUTHOR] [--notes NOTES]
                             path

Write a validated patch for desktop review without changing the document.

positional arguments:
  path             Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT      Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --patch PATCH    JSON patch or edit-preview file inside workspace.
  --title TITLE    Title shown to the person reviewing the proposal.
  --author AUTHOR  Proposal author (default: agent).
  --notes NOTES    Optional review notes.
session:
usage: hwp-workbench session [-h] [--root ROOT] path

Read Agent link state and proposal outcomes without writing.

positional arguments:
  path         Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
convert:
usage: hwp-workbench convert [-h] [--root ROOT] --to {hwp,hwpx,docx}
                             [-o OUTPUT] [--acknowledge-risks]
                             path

Report an explicit, lossy format export; optionally save a new file.

positional arguments:
  path                  Source HWP/HWPX path inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
  --to {hwp,hwpx,docx}  Requested export format.
  -o, --output OUTPUT   New output path with the target extension; must not
                        exist.
  --acknowledge-risks   Acknowledge conversion losses before writing.
mcp:
usage: hwp-workbench mcp [-h] --root ROOT

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Allowed document workspace.
mcp-config:
usage: hwp-workbench mcp-config [-h]
                                --client {claude-code,codex,claude-desktop,json}
                                --root ROOT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --client {claude-code,codex,claude-desktop,json}
                        Client setup format to print.
  --root ROOT           Existing document folder; home and / are refused.
open:
usage: hwp-workbench open [-h] [--root ROOT] path

positional arguments:
  path         Existing regular .hwp/.hwpx file inside the workspace.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Allowed workspace (default: current directory).
rpc:
usage: hwp-workbench rpc [-h] --root ROOT

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Allowed document workspace; desktop adapter only.
skill:
usage: hwp-workbench skill [-h] {install,status,uninstall} ...

positional arguments:
  {install,status,uninstall}
                        Skill management operation.
    install             Install the marked skill into selected agent folders.
    status              Show installed skill versions and paths as JSON.
    uninstall           Remove only folders marked as installed by this
                        application.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
skill install:
usage: hwp-workbench skill install [-h] [--target {claude,codex,all}]
                                   [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target {claude,codex,all}
                        Agent target (default: all).
  --dry-run             Validate and report destinations without writing.
skill status:
usage: hwp-workbench skill status [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
skill uninstall:
usage: hwp-workbench skill uninstall [-h] [--target {claude,codex,all}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target {claude,codex,all}
                        Agent target (default: all).
